question: In which year was the Sahitya Akademi Award started?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1954.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sahitya Akademi **is India's National Academy of Letters.
 
• The Government of India **established the Sahitya Akademi on 12 March 1954.**
 
• It was** first conferred in 1955.**
 
• It was set up by the Government but functioned as an** autonomous organization.**
 
• On 7 January 1956, it was registered as a society under the **Societies Registration Act, 1860.**
 
• It is conferred annually on 24 writers for their outstanding works published in **24 Indian languages recognized by the Akademi.**
 
• It has **recognized English and Rajasthani apart from the 22 languages enumerated in the Indian Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
